cars.name: Kogane Hachi RS
cars.silhouette: short wheelbase, narrow angular glasshouse, rectangular sealed lamps
cars.handling: Responsive rotation and gentle power; lower straight-line speed; free starter choice.

cars.name: Mizuno Kite GT
cars.silhouette: tall rear hatch, offset grille, wedge side windows
cars.handling: Predictable entry and wet confidence; throttle understeer; free starter choice.

cars.name: Arata Rainfox 4
cars.silhouette: squared arches, slim boot, divided rear lamps
cars.handling: Stable traction and forgiving exits; more weight and less free rotation; free starter choice.

cars.name: Kogane Kestrel S
cars.silhouette: low oval nose, small cabin, long open rear deck
cars.handling: Momentum-focused; needs clean exits; removable roof is cosmetic.

cars.name: Shinmei Linea 20
cars.silhouette: notched rear quarter, long bonnet, stacked corner lamps
cars.handling: Flexible tuning; moderate chassis mass; lieutenant-friendly early build.

cars.name: Mizuno Sparrow Type-S
cars.silhouette: short overhangs, arched roof, horizontal split grille
cars.handling: Quick front-end response; must manage front grip when powering out.

cars.name: Arata Shigure GT
cars.silhouette: long cargo roof, roof rails, six-window side profile
cars.handling: Composed rough-road exits; slow rotation and higher braking demand.

cars.name: Hokusei Lanceray R
cars.silhouette: compact trunk, raised hood intake, triangular lamp internals
cars.handling: Strong exits and wet lines; can understeer with an aggressive diff.

cars.name: Shinmei Crestline 26
cars.silhouette: broad shoulder, very long hood, recessed oval tail lamps
cars.handling: Stable fast arcs; less agile in hairpins; strong linear pull.

cars.name: Kogane Spiral RX
cars.silhouette: smooth teardrop cabin, rounded rear quarters, twin-slot lights
cars.handling: Fast response/high revs; careful ratio choice matters on steep climbs.

cars.name: Mizuno Vector MR
cars.silhouette: short nose, side cooling channels, angular buttresses
cars.handling: Precise rotation and balance; needs smooth braking release.

cars.name: Shinmei Stormline 32
cars.silhouette: broad rectangular silhouette, twin-intake nose, squared wing mounts
cars.handling: Powerful traction but expensive momentum mistakes; not best on every course.

cars.name: Arata Comet S6
cars.silhouette: low shark nose, tapered trunk, separate slim running lamps
cars.handling: Good high-speed balance; steeper costs and grip-sensitive peak tune.

cars.name: Hokusei Vale R
cars.silhouette: large fastback hatch, blade spoiler, tall front shoulders
cars.handling: Unusual high-power FWD challenge; braking/exit planning beats brute force.

cars.name: Kogane Halo T
cars.silhouette: short sculpted body, boxed rear haunches, low wraparound glass
cars.handling: Big midrange torque; boost delivery can unbalance poor throttle control.

cars.name: Mizuno Meridian X
cars.silhouette: low cabin-forward wedge, wide side intakes, deep rear diffuser
cars.handling: Quick and exacting; never a mandatory purchase or universal best car.

cars.name: Shinmei Aurora 4S
cars.silhouette: long roofline, muscular four-seat coupe stance, split rear bar
cars.handling: Strong acceleration/stability; heavier braking and tyre loading.

cars.name: Hokusei Solstice Z
cars.silhouette: compact cabin, deep sculpted doors, round-over rear deck
cars.handling: High performance with controllable rotation; an alternative, not a required finale key.
